form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Bennet introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance

form.official-title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to eliminate installment agreement fees for certain individuals.

section.header: Installment agreement fees eliminated for certain individuals

subsection.text: Section 6159(f) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by striking paragraph (2) and inserting the following:

paragraph.text: No fee shall be imposed on an installment agreement under this section in the case of any taxpayer with an adjusted gross income, as determined for the most recent year for which such information is available, which does not exceed 250 percent of the applicable poverty level (as determined by the Secretary).

subsection.text: The amendment made by this section shall apply to installment agreements entered into after the date which is 12 months after the date of enactment of this Act.
